decoded_transitions.work: ADD; CBZ on already-armed flag; LDAR completion flag; CBZ back. The unmasked path has no yield or call.

linked_image_witnesses.basis: Decoded PCs come from QEMU. Stack, timer, priority and register values below are inferred from fail-guarded instructions in the hashed ELF and the successful UART path.
linked_image_witnesses.timer: 0x40201688..0x402016a0 checks GICC_IAR INTID = 30 and CNTP_CTL bits [2:0] = 5; 0x40201710..0x40201720 disables CNTP, issues barriers, writes the original IAR token to GICC_EOIR. IRQ acceptance also checks saved ELR, SPSR for unmasked EL1h, nonzero X9 work count and HIGH_DONE = 0.
linked_image_witnesses.fixed_priority: Initial .data at 0x40202018..19 and 0x40202028..29 contains (priority 1, Ready 1) LOW and (priority 2, Blocked 0) HIGH. 0x40201760..0x40201770 records LOW frame, makes both Ready and invokes dispatch. Dispatch filters state == 1 and compares both actual priorities (CMP 0x40201944, CSELs). IRQ handler checks current HIGH and LOW Ready before emitting its marker.
linked_image_witnesses.high_finish: HIGH checks live entry SP and scheduler state before its UART bytes. SVC handler checks the syndrome, exact HIGH frame address and saved return label; at 0x40201524..0x40201550 HIGH becomes Finished, dispatch selects LOW, HIGH_DONE = 1 is release-stored.
linked_image_witnesses.restore: Vector subtracts 0x340 and saves X0-X30, Q0-Q31, ELR/SPSR, FPCR/FPSR, TPIDR_EL1, SP_EL0, TPIDR_EL0 and TPIDRRO_EL0. Saved frame pointer represents SP_EL1. Common return at 0x4020118c installs the selected frame as SP, restores the same register slots, adds 0x340, CLREX, ERET at 0x40201248.
linked_image_witnesses.live_values: HIGH clears X9, X12, X15, X19, V31, FPCR/FPSR, TPIDR_EL1 and NZCV before SVC. After the traced ERET, LOW exits with its acquired completion flag then checks Z=C=1, X15=0x15a5, X19=0x19b6, matching stack words, TPIDR_EL1=0x19b6, both V31 halves filled with 0x55, FPCR=0x400000 and FPSR=0x08000000. The final callback checks the original work SP, HIGH_DONE=1, current LOW and HIGH Finished. A mismatch branches to failure before the last two UART lines.

limitations: One cold boot, CPU and preemption pair. The 5 second timeout and 0.1 second quiet window are host observation settings.

Exception tracing records PCs and exception class, without independent GPR, SP, MMIO or task-table snapshots. Guarded value checks exercise selected witnesses; other saved registers received static inspection.
Boot-profile acceptance here replays EVD-001 bytes. The verifier launched no default-build guest and performed no rebuild.
Equal-priority FIFO, general lifecycle, SMP, time budgets, IRQ latency, worst-case timing, physical boards and product certification remain outside this case.
